children: New Delhi, Nov. 8 -- Shares Emami and Dabur India Limited surged nearly 7% over the last week after both the FMCG giants announced their second quarter results for the financial year 2026-27. Both the homegrown companies also announced dividends with record dates scheduled for the coming week.
While Emami reported a marginal 1.92% annual decline in its consolidated net profit, Dabur India's net profit after tax (PAT) surged by 12% on a yearly basis.

Emami is a diversified conglomerate with interests in FMCG, edible oils, food, paper and real estate, Dabur India is a consumer goods company focused on healthcare, personal care, hair care and oral care. Here's a detailed analysis of how the two homegrown FMCG players performed.

Emami's net profit declined 1.92% on an annual basis to Rs.145.50 crore for September quarter of financial year 2026-27. Elevated input costs and normalisation of the effective tax rate impacted the profitability. Its net revenue from operations increased by 36.2% on an annual basis to Rs.1,087.65 crore in the September quarter under review.

Dabur India's profit increased 12.09% to Rs.498.57 crore in Q2FY27. Its net profit came in at Rs.444.79 crore in July-September FY26. Its net revenue from operations increased by 11.74% to Rs.3,563.07 crore in Q2 FY27 from Rs.3,191.32 crore a year ago.

Emami's board of directors announced Rs.5 per share dividend for FY27. The board has fixed November 13 as the record date to determine the eligibility of shareholders for the payout. Meanwhile, Dabur India's board of directors approved Rs.3.50 per share dividend for FY27 and fixed November 9 as the record date.

Motilal Oswal gave a 'Neutral' rating for Dabur India stock with a target price of Rs.425 per share. "The strategy refresh in six months should provide better visibility on the next leg of growth. We reiterate our Neutral rating on the stock with a TP of INR425 (30x Sep'28E EPS)."

The brokerage maintained its 'Buy' rating for the stock with a target price of Rs.475 per share. "Given its reasonable valuations of 19x/16x FY28/FY29 EPS, we reiterate our BUY rating with a TP of INR475 (based on 20x on Sep'28 EPS)."
Emami share price closed higher at Rs.387.05 per share on Friday. THe FMCG stock has delivered 7.54% returns over the last one week, 3.75% return in two weeks and around 1.34% return in one year.

Dabur India share price closed at Rs.385.50 per share on BSE on Friday. Its share price value has surged 4.37% in one week, but declined 1.65% in one month. Its share price value has declined 27% in one year.
